Name: Main System-on-Chip
Product Name: Custom High-Performance Mobile SoC (e.g., A17 Bionic equivalent)

Name: 5G/Wi-Fi 7/BT 5.4 Module
Description: Integrated module for high-speed 5G cellular and Wi-Fi 7 wireless connectivity.

Name: Main Wide-Angle Camera
Description: High-resolution large sensor camera module for exceptional image quality in various lighting conditions, a key component for an 'all-rounder' camera.

Name: Front-Facing Camera
Description: Front-facing camera optimized for selfies and video calls, with good low-light performance.

Name: Accelerometer & Gyroscope
Description: 6-axis IMU for motion sensing and orientation.

Name: Magnetometer
Description: Electronic compass for device orientation.

Name: Under-Display Fingerprint Sensor
Description: Ultrasonic under-display fingerprint sensor for biometric authentication.

Name: Unibody Chassis
Description: Precision-machined titanium unibody chassis, forming the primary structure and external housing.

Name: Display Cover Glass
Description: Ultra-hardened glass panel covering and protecting the AMOLED display.

Name: Rear Cover Glass
Description: Hardened glass panel forming the rear of the device, adhering to the unibody chassis.

Name: Internal Midframe
Description: Lightweight magnesium alloy midframe providing internal rigidity and mounting points for PCB and components.

Name: Vapor Chamber
Description: Advanced ultra-thin vapor chamber for efficient heat dissipation from the SoC and mainboard.

Description: Flexible graphite sheet for further heat spreading and dissipation, positioned above the main components.

Description: Tactile metal button for power control, integrated into the chassis side.

Description: Integrated metal rocker button for volume adjustment on the chassis side.

Name: SIM Card Tray
Description: Ejectable tray for dual Nano SIM cards, flush with the chassis.

Name: USB-C Port Gasket
Description: Silicone gasket for waterproofing and dust protection around the USB-C port.

Name: Top Speaker Grill
Description: Acoustically transparent, micro-perforated grill for the top earpiece/speaker.
